findings.evidence: User support-message flow accepts any active user and then checks only ticket existence: addSupportMessage builds an idempotent action for the caller/ticket, but addTicketMessage validates with ticket(" WHERE id=?", ticketId) and inserts the message without requiring support_tickets.user_id to match the caller. A user who knows another ticket id can append messages to it.
findings.issue: Missing ticket ownership authorization on user support replies.
findings.requirement_ref: 权限/幂等/错误码/审计覆盖

findings.evidence: Admin decision requests require expectedVersion, but decide() uses it only in the request hash and returned CommandResult; the UPDATE is WHERE id=? AND status='PENDING' with no version predicate or persisted version increment. The same pattern appears in support assign/close, allowing stale expectedVersion requests to mutate records while returning expected+1 as if optimistic locking succeeded.
findings.issue: expectedVersion contract is not enforced on mutable admin decisions/support state transitions.
findings.requirement_ref: 权限/幂等/错误码/审计覆盖
